house.description: Express statement of application to county-based purchasing for a medical assistance modification required to apply to county-based purchasing, and estimates of local fiscal impacts to counties or groups of counties administering a county-based purchasing plan.

House.text: Introduction and first reading, referred to Health Finance and Policy

bill_text.text_with_changes:
A bill for an act relating to medical assistance; requiring an express statement of application to county-based purchasing for a medical assistance modification to apply to county-based purchasing; requiring estimates of local fiscal impacts to counties or groups of counties administering a county-based purchasing plan; amending Minnesota Statutes 2024, section 256B.692, by adding a subdivision.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1.
Minnesota Statutes 2024, section 256B.692, is amended by adding a subdivision to read:

[+Subd. 11.+]

[+Modifications to medical assistance.+]

[+(a) Any modification to the entity administering, or with primary control over the administration of, a benefit or service required to be covered by medical assistance does not apply to county-based purchasing unless: +]

[+(1) the modification is expressly described in this section; and +]

[+(2) the commissioner has published the written estimate of local fiscal impacts described in paragraph (c). +]

[+(b) Any modification to the benefits or services required to be covered by medical assistance does not apply to county-based purchasing unless: +]

[+(1) the modification is expressly described in this section; and +]

[+(2) the commissioner has published the written estimate of local fiscal impacts described in paragraph (c). +]

[+(c) Before the effective date of a modification described in paragraph (a) or (b), the commissioner must publish a written estimate of the local fiscal impacts to counties or groups of counties administering county-based purchasing arising from the modification. +]

[+EFFECTIVE DATE.+]

[+This section is effective the day following final enactment. +]
bill_text.plain_text:
A bill for an act relating to medical assistance; requiring an express statement of application to county-based purchasing for a medical assistance modification to apply to county-based purchasing; requiring estimates of local fiscal impacts to counties or groups of counties administering a county-based purchasing plan; amending Minnesota Statutes 2024, section 256B.692, by adding a subdivision.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1.
Minnesota Statutes 2024, section 256B.692, is amended by adding a subdivision to read:

Subd. 11.

Modifications to medical assistance.

(a) Any modification to the entity administering, or with primary control over the administration of, a benefit or service required to be covered by medical assistance does not apply to county-based purchasing unless:

(1) the modification is expressly described in this section; and

(2) the commissioner has published the written estimate of local fiscal impacts described in paragraph (c).

(b) Any modification to the benefits or services required to be covered by medical assistance does not apply to county-based purchasing unless:

(1) the modification is expressly described in this section; and

(2) the commissioner has published the written estimate of local fiscal impacts described in paragraph (c).

(c) Before the effective date of a modification described in paragraph (a) or (b), the commissioner must publish a written estimate of the local fiscal impacts to counties or groups of counties administering county-based purchasing arising from the modification.

EFFECTIVE DATE.

This section is effective the day following final enactment.
